title: Opposition MPs rally outside Belgrade police station for detained TV owner
seoTitle: Belgrade rally for detained TV owner

tea.why: Opposition lawmakers and supporters gathered to protest the detention of Informer TV owner Dragan J. Vucicevic.
tea.want: The protesters demanded the release of the detained media owner, claiming his arrest was politically motivated.
tea.changed: Nov 25: Lawmakers from the Serbia Wins group and the Serbian Radical Party rallied outside the Vozdovac police station.

summary: On November 25, 2026, members of the Serbian Parliament, including representatives from the Serbia Wins parliamentary group and the Serbian Radical Party, held a protest outside the Vozdovac police station in Belgrade. The demonstration followed the detention of Dragan J. Vucicevic, the owner of Informer TV, who was taken into custody by order of the Second Basic Public Prosecutor’s Office on charges of inciting panic and disorder and obstructing justice. Aleksandar Vucic, head of the Serbia Wins group, stated in parliament that the detention was linked to the media owner's professional work. During the rally, some participants engaged in verbal confrontations with media personnel. The protest concluded after the lawmakers left the parliamentary session to show their support for the detained individual.
response: The Second Basic Public Prosecutor’s Office stated that the suspect was detained on suspicion of extended incitement to panic and disorder and obstruction of justice, with a scheduled hearing for November 26.

updates.text: Lawmakers walked out of parliament to protest at the Vozdovac police station following the detention of the Informer TV owner.
